subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin memorySearch.extraPaths ingest arbitrary JSONL raw message logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay in a QMD/session-memory/converter/plugin workflow?
rationale: The request widens builtin memory from Markdown/multimodal/session-owned inputs into arbitrary structured logs that may contain private messages, tool output, and secrets, so automation should not choose the security/product boundary.

options.title: Document Supported Alternative
options.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add Native Builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware parsing, watcher and memory_get support, tests, docs, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Defer For Plugin API Design
options.body: Keep this open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document Supported Alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided maintainer-side context on this issue and has recent history in the memory host/runtime boundary.
